text: ＊　ポケモンずかんを　みごと　かんせい　させた　いだいなこうせきを　たたえ　ここに　しょうめい　します
note: The wording follows the fixed formula of a Japanese award certificate (表彰状), which typically ends by praising the achievement and declaring ここに…します; a Japanese reader recognises the diploma at once.
claim: Japanese award certificates (表彰状) conventionally use set phrases such as 功績をたたえ and ここに表彰します.
